userStories.title: JP direct diffusion configs for insert and scoop
userStories.description: Create experiment YAML configs for insert_onto_square_peg and scoop_with_spatula using joint_position_direct action pipeline with diffusion head, DINO+Depth LoRA8 vision. These tasks have 0% and 20% replay ceiling with JV direct, so JP direct is mandatory. Use the existing experiments/sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jvdirect.yaml as template but change: (1) action_pipeline_preset to joint_position_direct, (2) action_output_activation to identity, (3) action_min/max to actual robot joint position limits [-2.8973,-1.7628,-2.8973,-3.0718,-2.8973,-0.0175,-2.8973,0.0] and max [2.8973,1.7628,2.8973,-0.0698,2.8973,3.7525,2.8973,1.0]. Create two files: experiments/insert_sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jpdirect.yaml and experiments/scoop_sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jpdirect.yaml with task field set appropriately.

userStories.title: JP servo diffusion configs for insert and scoop
userStories.description: Create experiment YAML configs for insert_onto_square_peg and scoop_with_spatula using joint_position_to_benchmark_joint_velocity_servo action pipeline with diffusion head, DINO+Depth LoRA8 vision. This is an alternative to JP direct that keeps the benchmark JV interface but uses a servo adapter. Use servo params: gain=20, clip=1.0, steps=2, tolerance=0.01. Create: experiments/insert_sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jpservo.yaml and experiments/scoop_sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jpservo.yaml. Use the same template as US-001 but with action_pipeline_preset: joint_position_to_benchmark_joint_velocity_servo and add joint_velocity_servo_gain/clip/steps/tolerance fields under dataset section.

userStories.title: Close box separate gripper head with longer training config
userStories.description: Create an experiment config for close_box that combines: (1) DINO+Depth LoRA8 vision_backbone: dinov3_depth_anything_small_frozen, (2) diffusion head, (3) separate_gripper_head: true with gripper_loss_weight: 4.0, (4) JV direct action. Create: experiments/close_box_sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jvdirect_splitgripper_e100.yaml. Copy from experiments/sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jvdirect_splitgripper.yaml and add task: close_box.

userStories.title: Create unified 4-task experiment launcher script
userStories.description: Create a bash script scripts/start_jp_diffusion_4task_tmux.sh that launches same-env training for all 4 tasks on 4 GPUs. The script should: (1) accept SESSION_NAME and optional RUN_SUFFIX args, (2) create a tmux session with 4 windows, (3) each window runs: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=N python scripts/train_same_env_bcpolicy_probe.py --task TASK --dataset-config-path CONFIG --epochs 50 --eval-episodes 20 --device cuda:0 --seed 0 --run-name TASK_RUN_SUFFIX. Use JP direct configs for insert (experiments/insert_sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jpdirect.yaml) and scoop (experiments/scoop_sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jpdirect.yaml), and existing JV configs for slide (experiments/sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jvdirect.yaml) and close_box (experiments/close_box_sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jvdirect_splitgripper_e100.yaml). chmod +x the script.
acceptanceCriteria: Script uses CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES for GPU assignment

userStories.title: Fix diffusion head clamp bug for JP actions
userStories.description: In elsa_learning_agent/agent.py, the _sample_diffusion method (around line 1382) ends with 'return current.clamp(-1.0, 1.0)'. This hard clamp is correct for JV actions (bounds [-1,1]) but problematic for JP actions where the diffusion model works in normalized [-1,1] space during training but the clamp can destroy information during iterative denoising. Fix: replace the hard clamp with 'return self.output_activation(current)' so that JV (tanh) still gets bounded to [-1,1] and JP (identity) passes through without lossy clamping. The denormalization in live_rollout.py already handles the final clamping correctly. IMPORTANT: only change the return line in _sample_diffusion, do not modify any other code.
